title: City or Not City? Chongqing Runs a Train Through a Building | China Travel Expert
description:
"City… or not city?" — the phrase blew up on TikTok and Douyin, and no place answers it like Chongqing. This is the city where a monorail runs clean through the 6th-to-8th floors of a 19-storey residential block at Liziba station, where roads and railways stack level over level up a river gorge until you genuinely can't tell which floor counts as the ground.

People online call it China's "8D magic city," and honestly the clips don't oversell it. Walk it in first person and the whole place feels built in three dimensions at once.

So you tell me: real city, or a video game you can walk around in?

★ Expert Tip: ride Rail Transit Line 2 to Liziba just to feel the train pass through the building — it's free to look from the public viewing platform.

"city不city"这个梗在海外爆火，而重庆最能回答它：李子坝轻轨穿楼而过（19层楼的6-8层），道路立体层叠，被叫作"8D魔幻城市"。
